problem: These four weapon models were the entire remaining player-equipment gap: avatar_items.json named them through m_pstrMMeshModelString but resolved no model. No existing tool could install them. install-player-equipment targets the retired characters/player/equipment/ layout and the global asset-manifest.json that the asset migration removed, and verify_player_item_sets now rejects that directory outright; install-character-creation-data indexes the tree through the same removed manifest. Two narrow, tracked tools were added instead of resurrecting either.

newTools.purpose: Append GPU-accepted equipment models to the organized characters/player/items layout, reproducing the organizer's own identity derivation.
newTools.identityProof: item id = 'player-item-' + blake3('characters/player/equipment/<category>/<trueName>/<trueName>.glb'); a single-member set id is 'player-item-set-' + the same hash. The unit test pins this against the installed back_alien id fc2d2f7c765af95c9d3cddbee4e45b8320ebbd7dd23031e57c4bbf634f09d86f.

newTools.purpose: Fill in avatar_items.json model entries whose modelStatus is missing while the installed player-item catalog publishes their sourceModelTrueName. It never edits a resolved entry and never touches a slot whose XDT row names no model.
